$comment: Justified exceptions for scripts/audit-design-system.mjs. `file` is a glob relative to the repo root, `rule` is a rule id or `*`, optional `match` is a regex tested against the snippet or the whole line. Every entry needs a `reason`.

entries.reason: Mask rect/stroke inside the SVG mask must be literal #fff/#000; not a theme colour.
Warning tint mixed from a token; a --rm-warning-tint token would retire this.
Search <mark> highlight inside running text; below the radius scale on purpose.
Theme swatches render the theme's own palette, not the active theme (7.1).
Theme preview renders the previewed theme's own palette, not the active theme (7.1).
rm-loading-exit runs 1.2s: a loader dissolving into the app, not UI motion (10.1).
Marketing page has its own responsive ladder (decision 8); not the app shell.
Dev-only debug tool, not shipped UI (decision 8).
